capabilities: Edit .docx documents with WYSIWYG rich-text editing and lossless OOXML round-tripping
Edit .xlsx, .csv, and .tsv spreadsheets in a multi-sheet grid with formulas and cell formatting
Edit .pptx slide decks and present them as fullscreen slideshows with transitions
Highlight, annotate, and draw on PDFs, saving losslessly to the original binary
Autosave edits back to the original files in the vault
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); mobile is not supported. Beta releases are available via BRAT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian only edits Markdown natively, so office documents and PDFs must be opened in external apps or converted, breaking the workflow and losing formatting.

relations.evidence: You can test the latest beta releases using the Obsidian BRAT plugin

summary: All-in-one editor that views and edits Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx/.csv/.tsv), PowerPoint (.pptx), and PDF files natively inside Obsidian.
